**ID:** Thig 3.6
**Section:** Therīgāthā (thig)
**Collection:** Sutta
**Title (Pali):** Sukkātherīgāthā
**tipitaka.org (CST):** https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0509m.mul2.xml

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Sukkā's life and verses are further expanded in the *Apadāna* (*Sukkātherīapadāna*, Thi-Ap 35) [Rhys Davids 1917].

**Parallels and text reuse**

- Passage-level parallels: SN 10.9 Paṭhamasukkāsutta
- Mentioned in: Thi-Ap 35 Sukkātherīapadāna

**Sources**

- [Rhys Davids 1917] C. A. F. Rhys Davids, The Book of the Kindred Sayings, Part I (1917) — Account of Sukkā and the yakkha verse in Rājagaha and reference to the Apadāna and commentary
- [Hazra 1994] Kanai Lal Hazra, Pāli Language and Literature (1994) — Note on the yakkha interested in the nun Sukkā in the Samyutta Nikāya
- [Collett 2014] Alice Collett (ed.), Women in Early Indian Buddhism: Comparative Textual Studies (2014) — Confirmation of Sukkā's authorship of Therīgāthā stanzas and mention elsewhere in discourses
